question.text: Will Ekrem İmamoğlu be convicted of a crime during Q4 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question will resolve as Yes if during October, November, or December 2026, Ekrem İmamoğlu is convicted of a crime by a Turkish criminal court.
question.fine_print: This question refers to receiving a guilty verdict. Pending appeals will not prevent this question from resolving Yes.

research:
I didn't make a forecast. The main finding: a verdict is possible as early as **November 11, 2026**, in the CHP congress case. In that case the prosecutor has already asked the court to convict İmamoğlu. Four of his trials have hearings scheduled before year-end.

## 1. Resolution source
- No official data series decides this. It resolves on news of a guilty verdict from a Turkish criminal court in any of İmamoğlu's cases, not only the big İBB trial. The best running list of cases is the [Turkish Wikipedia page on his cases](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ekrem_%C4%B0mamo%C4%9Flu_hakk%C4%B1ndaki_davalar_ve_soru%C5%9Fturmalar). It gives these hearing dates: expert-witness case Dec 8, 2026; diploma case Dec 25, 2026.

## 2. Current status
- I found no conviction so far in October 2026 or November 1-3, 2026. Nothing has settled the question yet.
- 2026-09-11: He was sentenced to 2 years 1 month plus a political ban for insulting former Tuzla mayor Şadi Yazıcı. This was a retrial after his earlier acquittals were overturned on appeal. It happened in Q3, so it does not count. [Diken](https://www.diken.com.tr/beraat-karari-bozulmustu-imamogluna-iki-yil-bir-ay-hapis/), [AA](https://www.aa.com.tr/tr/gundem/ekrem-imamoglu-hakaret-sucundan-2-yil-1-ay-hapse-carptirildi/4054249)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-03: The 103rd hearing of the İBB "criminal organization" trial took place at the Istanbul 33rd Heavy Penal Court, with 436 defendants. Businessmen testified about alleged bribes. The trial is still hearing witnesses, and prosecutors seek up to roughly 2,430 years for İmamoğlu. A verdict in Q4 looks implausible. [Haberler](https://www.haberler.com/guncel/imamoglu-nun-da-sanik-oldugu-436-sanikli-davada-20390405-haberi/), [Takvim](https://www.takvim.com.tr/guncel/2026/11/03/ibb-davasinda-is-adami-itiraf-etti-4-milyon-dolari-cantayla-teslim-ettim), [Hürriyet](https://www.hurriyet.com.tr/gundem/imamoglu-cikar-amacli-suc-orgutu-davasi-102-durusmasi-basladi-43363212)
- 2026-10-21: In the CHP 38th Congress case (Ankara 26th Criminal Court of First Instance), the prosecutor gave the final opinion on the merits. It seeks 1-3 years for İmamoğlu and eight others for vote rigging under Article 112 of the Political Parties Law, plus loss of certain rights. The hearing was adjourned to **2026-11-11 at 10:00**, when the defense responds to that opinion. In Turkish practice a verdict often follows at that stage, but I could not confirm one is expected that day. [Evrensel](https://www.evrensel.net/haber/6005930/chpnin-38-olagan-kurultayi-davasi-imamogluna-ceza-akp-gecen-cemil-tugaya-beraat-talebi), [Adana Toros](https://adanatorosgazetesi.net/chp-kurultay-ceza-davasinda-mutalaa-aciklandi-durusma-11-kasima-ertelendi), [Haberler](https://www.haberler.com/guncel/chp-kurultayi-davasinda-savci-imamoglu-dahil-9-20351646-haberi/)
- 2026-09-29: The political espionage case (15-20 years sought) was adjourned to 2026-12-23, and he remains in detention. [Sol](https://haber.sol.org.tr/haber/casusluk-davasinda-karar-imamoglu-yanardag-ozkan-ve-gunun-tutuklulugu-devam-edecek-414407), [Diken](https://www.diken.com.tr/casusluk-davasi-imamoglu-dahil-dort-isim-icin-tutukluluga-devam-karari-2/)
- 2026-07-13: The expert-witness case was adjourned to Dec 8 because the prosecutor changed. The "influencing an expert" charge had been dropped and the remaining charge allows a pre-payment (ön ödeme), which his lawyers made. The case was expected to be dismissed, not to end in a conviction. [BirGün](https://www.birgun.net/haber/dusmesi-bekleniyordu-imamoglu-nun-bilirkisi-davasi-8-aralik-a-ertelendi-723596)
- 2026-07-06: The diploma forgery case (up to 8 years 9 months sought) was adjourned to Dec 25. The court is waiting for the Council of State (Danıştay) to rule on the cancellation of his diploma, and I found no Danıştay ruling yet. [GZT](https://www.gzt.com/gundem/ekrem-imamoglunun-yargilandigi-diploma-davasi-25-aralika-ertelendi-4238810), [Medyascope](https://medyascope.tv/2026/06/17/imamoglunun-diplomasinin-iptaline-karsi-actigi-dava-danistaya-tasindi-basvuruyu-mehmet-pehlivan-yapti/)

## 4. Base rates
- First-instance convictions so far:
  - 2021-03-17: judicial fine for insulting the Ordu governor
  - 2022-12-14: insulting election board (YSK) members
  - 2025-07-16: insulting and threatening prosecutor Akın Gürlek
  - 2026-09-11: Şadi Yazıcı insult case
- That is about four convictions in about 5.5 years. The pace has picked up since 2025: two in the past 16 months.
- Acquittals and dismissals also happen: Beylikdüzü tender acquittal on 2025-10-24, and two insult cases dismissed after pre-payment. [Wikipedia TR](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ekrem_%C4%B0mamo%C4%9Flu_hakk%C4%B1ndaki_davalar_ve_soru%C5%9Fturmalar)
- Courts have often adjourned instead of ruling. The diploma case alone has been adjourned five times.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no market on a conviction specifically.
- Polymarket, "İmamoğlu released from custody in 2026?": 4.7% Yes. This is related but is not the same question.
- Kalshi, Turkish presidential election: İmamoğlu at 18% to win the 2028 first round and 12% to win the next election. This only reflects his perceived political viability, not conviction odds.
- I found no Manifold or Metaculus market that matches this question.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- **2026-11-11: CHP congress case.** The defense responds to the prosecutor's opinion, and a verdict is possible. This looks like the most important date.
- 2026-12-08: Expert-witness case. Dismissal is more likely than a conviction.
- 2026-12-23: Espionage case hearing.
- 2026-12-25: Diploma case. This depends on the Danıştay ruling.
- The İBB trial continues through the quarter, but no verdict is expected.
- New indictments could add cases: several investigations are open at the Bakırköy prosecutor's office, plus the Kent Uzlaşısı and concert-spending probes.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question names no specific data series. It resolves on whether any Turkish criminal court finds İmamoğlu guilty between 2026-10-01 and 2026-12-31, so news reports of a verdict in any of his cases will decide it. The BBC background article is about the main İBB corruption trial. [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cj6ng120pggo)
- As of 2026-11-03, I found no guilty verdict against him in Q4 2026.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. His most recent conviction was on 2026-09-11, before the window opened: 2 years 1 month in prison plus a political ban, in the retrial over insulting former Tuzla mayor Şadi Yazıcı. That sentence is not enforceable until it becomes final. [Turkish Minute](https://www.turkishminute.com/2026/09/11/jailed-istanbul-mayor-imamoglu-sentenced-to-2-years-in-insult-case/), [BirGün](https://www.birgun.net/haber/imamoglu-sentenced-to-two-years-and-one-month-in-prison-and-given-a-political-ban-in-a-case-in-which-he-had-previously-been-acquitted-twice-734201)
- Several cases have hearings in November and December. At least one, the CHP congress case, has already reached the prosecutor's final opinion (mütalaa).

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-03: The 103rd hearing of the main İBB "criminal organization" trial took place (436 defendants, 46 detained). Businessman Nezih Barut testified that he handed over a $4 million bribe in a bag. [Takvim](https://www.takvim.com.tr/guncel/2026/11/03/ibb-davasinda-is-adami-itiraf-etti-4-milyon-dolari-cantayla-teslim-ettim), [Haberler](https://www.haberler.com/guncel/imamoglu-nun-da-sanik-oldugu-436-sanikli-davada-20390405-haberi/)

I found no mütalaa date and no verdict date. [Habertürk](https://haberturk.com/gundem/imamoglu-davasinin-102-durusmasinda-taniklarin-para-teslimine-iliskin-ifadeleri-dinlendi-3924400), [Hürriyet](https://www.hurriyet.com.tr/gundem/imamoglu-cikar-amacli-suc-orgutu-davasi-102-durusmasi-basladi-43363212)

It asks for İmamoğlu and eight others to be punished under Article 112 of the Political Parties Law, together with Turkish Penal Code Articles 37/1 and 53/1, and for Cemil Tugay to be acquitted. The case was adjourned to 11 November. The article gives no sentence figure. [Evrensel](https://www.evrensel.net/haber/6005930/chpnin-38-olagan-kurultayi-davasi-imamogluna-ceza-akp-gecen-cemil-tugaya-beraat-talebi)
- 2026-10-17: In the İBB trial, the court released 7 defendants but kept İmamoğlu in detention and adjourned to 2 November. [Milli Gazete](https://www.milligazete.com.tr/ibb-davasinda-son-durum-ne-imamoglu-serbest-birakildi-mi-7-tahliye-edilen-kim-kac-tutuklu-kaldi)
- 2026-09-29: In the espionage case (15 to 20 years sought), detention was continued and the case adjourned to 23 December. [Diken](https://www.diken.com.tr/casusluk-davasi-imamoglu-dahil-dort-isim-icin-tutukluluga-devam-karari-2/)
- 2026-07-13: The expert witness ("bilirkişi") case was adjourned to 8 December because a new prosecutor asked for time to review the file. One charge (Article 277) had earlier been ruled inapplicable. The remaining Article 288 charge qualifies for pre-payment (ön ödeme), and his lawyers paid. That could lead to the case being dropped rather than a conviction. [Takvim](https://www.takvim.com.tr/guncel/2026/07/13/imamoglunun-bilirkisi-davasi-8-aralika-ertelendi), [Cumhuriyet](https://www.cumhuriyet.com.tr/turkiye/imamoglu-nun-yargilandigi-bilirkisi-davasinda-mutalaa-aciklandi-bir-suclama-dustu-on-odeme-ihtimali-dogdu-2490736)
- 2026-07-06: The diploma forgery case (2 years 6 months to 8 years 9 months sought) was adjourned to 25 December. The court is waiting for the Council of State (Danıştay) to rule on the related administrative case. [CNN Türk](https://www.cnnturk.com/turkiye/son-dakika-imamoglunun-diploma-davasi-25-aralika-ertelendi-3439386)

## 4. Base rates
- Past criminal convictions: December 2022 (calling election board members "fools", 2 years 7 months, upheld on appeal in September 2025), 2025-07-16 (remarks about prosecutor Akın Gürlek, 1 year 8 months) and 2026-09-11 (Tuzla insult retrial). That is 3 convictions in about 4 years, and 2 in the last roughly 15 months. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2025/07/16/europe/turkey-court-convicts-mayor-ekrem-imamoglu-intl-hnk), [Vikipedi](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ekrem_%C4%B0mamo%C4%9Flu_hakk%C4%B1ndaki_davalar_ve_soru%C5%9Fturmalar)
- Not every case ended in conviction: he was acquitted in the Beylikdüzü bid-rigging case (2025-10-24), and two insult cases were dropped after pre-payment (October 2025 and March 2026). [Vikipedi](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ekrem_%C4%B0mamo%C4%9Flu_hakk%C4%B1ndaki_davalar_ve_soru%C5%9Fturmalar)
- His cases are often postponed. The diploma case alone has been adjourned at least 5 times.
- In Turkish procedure, the verdict often comes one or two sessions after the mütalaa, once the defense has responded on the merits. In the Gürlek case, the mütalaa came shortly before the July 2025 conviction.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I could not find any prediction market specifically on İmamoğlu being convicted.
- Related market: Polymarket "Ekrem İmamoğlu released from custody in 2026?" trades at Yes 4.7%, consistent with continued detention but not a direct measure of conviction.
- Kalshi's Turkish presidential markets are only indirectly relevant: İmamoğlu is at 18% to win the 2028 first round and 12% to win the next election.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-11-11: Next hearing in the CHP congress criminal case. The mütalaa has been delivered, so the defense may answer it and a verdict is possible, though not confirmed. [Evrensel](https://www.evrensel.net/haber/6005930/chpnin-38-olagan-kurultayi-davasi-imamogluna-ceza-akp-gecen-cemil-tugaya-beraat-talebi)
- 2026-12-08: Expert witness case hearing, where the new prosecutor's mütalaa is expected. Because the pre-payment was made, dismissal is a possible outcome.
- 2026-12-23: Espionage case hearing.
- 2026-12-25: Diploma forgery case hearing, which depends on the Danıştay ruling.
- Ongoing: The main İBB trial holds near-daily hearings. One summary said the judge hoped to finish "in about two weeks", but I could not verify this. The Habertürk article contained no such statement, and the court set a maximum trial duration of 4,600 days.
- A conviction in the 2022 "fools" case becoming final at the Court of Cassation (Yargıtay) would probably not count as a new guilty verdict by a criminal court.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) About 8 weeks remain, from Nov 3 to Dec 31, 2026. Yes requires any Turkish criminal court to issue a first-instance guilty verdict against İmamoğlu in Q4 2026. Pending appeals do not matter.

(b) The status quo is No. There has been no conviction in Q4 so far, and most of his trials are slow or keep being adjourned.

(c) Base rate: about 4 first-instance convictions in roughly 5.5 years gives about 0.2 per quarter. Since 2025 the pace is 2 in 16 months, or about 0.35-0.4 per quarter. That suggests a base of roughly 30-35% for a random quarter. The specific case pipeline matters more than this rate.

(d) Evidence:
- **For Yes:**
  - On Oct 21, 2026, the prosecutor gave the final opinion on the merits (mütalaa) in the CHP 38th Congress case, seeking 1-3 years for İmamoğlu.
  - That case was adjourned to Nov 11 for the defense to respond, which in courts of first instance is often the verdict session.
  - Turkish courts in politically salient cases against İmamoğlu have usually convicted once a verdict is reached: the Sept 11, 2026 Yazıcı retrial and the July 2025 Gürlek case.
  - Other hearings follow on Dec 8, Dec 23 and Dec 25.
- **For No:**
  - With 9 or more defendants, the defense responses may take more than one session, pushing the verdict past Nov 11, possibly into 2027.
  - The İBB trial verdict is implausible this quarter.
  - The expert-witness case is expected to be dismissed after the pre-payment.
  - The diploma case is waiting on the Danıştay ruling.
  - The espionage case is still in progress.
  - Courts have frequently adjourned, and there was a Beylikdüzü acquittal in Oct 2025.

(e) Scenarios:
- **No:** On Nov 11 the defense asks for time, or the court gives a later date. A December hearing is adjourned again, or the court acquits on the congress charge for political-tactical reasons. The other cases are all adjourned.
- **Yes:** On Nov 11 or at a December hearing, the Ankara 26th Criminal Court of First Instance convicts İmamoğlu of vote rigging under Article 112 of the Political Parties Law.

(f) Reasoning: I start from a base of about 30-35%. For the congress case:
- Chance of a verdict within Q4 after the final opinion: about 65%.
- Chance it is a conviction if a verdict comes: about 75%.
- Together that gives about 49%.

Other cases add a few points: the diploma case if Danıştay rules, the risk that the expert-witness case is not dismissed, and possible retrials. Overlap and slippage risk pull it back slightly. Net: about 52%.

Probability: 52%

(a) The window runs from now (Nov 3) to Dec 31, 2026, about 8 weeks. Yes requires any Turkish criminal court to issue a first-instance guilty verdict against İmamoğlu in Q4 2026, in any case. Appeals do not matter.

(b) Status quo: no conviction yet in Q4. Of the pending cases, only the CHP congress case is at the verdict stage, so if nothing moves, the answer is No. But the courts' existing schedule makes a verdict quite possible.

(c) Base rate:
- İmamoğlu has had about four first-instance convictions in about 5.5 years, and two in the last 16 months.
- That pace gives roughly a 25-35% chance of a conviction in any given quarter.
- A more useful reference class: Turkish first-instance criminal cases where the prosecutor has given a final opinion (mütalaa) seeking conviction of a high-profile opposition figure. These usually end within one or two hearings, with conviction rates of about 70-80%.

(d) Evidence:
- **For Yes:**
  - On Oct 21, 2026, the prosecutor in the CHP 38th Congress case gave the final opinion seeking 1-3 years for İmamoğlu.
  - The defense responds on Nov 11. In Turkish practice the verdict often comes at that hearing or the next one, which would likely still fall in Q4.
  - The judiciary has recently convicted him repeatedly: Jul 2025, and Sep 11, 2026 on retrial after acquittals were overturned.
  - Further hearings fall on Dec 23 (espionage) and Dec 25 (diploma).
- **For No:**
  - The case has many defendants, and the defense may ask for more time, which could push the verdict into 2027.
  - The case is politically sensitive alongside the related civil case over annulling the congress.
  - The diploma case is waiting on the Council of State (Danıştay).
  - The expert-witness case is likely to be dismissed after pre-payment.
  - The İBB and espionage trials are far from a verdict.

(e) Scenarios:
- **No:** On Nov 11 the defense asks for extra time and the court adjourns to January or February 2027. The diploma case is adjourned again on Dec 25 while it waits for the Danıştay ruling.
- **Yes:** On Nov 11, after the defense statements, the Ankara 26th Criminal Court of First Instance sentences İmamoğlu to about 1.5-2 years under Article 112 of the Political Parties Law.

(f) Estimate:
- Chance of a CHP congress verdict in Q4: about 65%.
- Chance it is a conviction, given a verdict: about 75%.
- That gives about 49% from this case.
- Adding small contributions from the diploma case, other hearings and possible new cases brings the total to about 53-55%.
- I move up from the per-quarter base rate of about 30% because one case has reached the final-opinion stage, with a scheduled hearing well inside the window.

Probability: 54%

(a) About 2 months remain, until December 31, 2026. A Yes needs any Turkish criminal court to issue a guilty verdict against İmamoğlu in any case between October 1 and December 31, 2026. Appeals do not matter. No conviction has occurred so far this quarter (through November 3).

(b) If nothing changes, the answer is No. Courts keep adjourning, and the large İBB trial will not finish this year.

(c) Base rate: there have been about 4 first-instance convictions in about 5.5 years, roughly 22 quarters, so about 18% per quarter. Since 2025 the pace is higher, 2 convictions in about 5 quarters, or about 35-40% per quarter. Quarters with a case at the final-opinion stage, like this one, should sit above that average.

(d) Evidence:
- **For Yes:**
  - On October 21, 2026, the prosecutor in the CHP 38th Congress case gave the final opinion on the merits. It seeks 1-3 years for İmamoğlu under Political Parties Law Article 112.
  - The defense responds on November 11. In Turkish practice the verdict is often read at that hearing or the next one.
  - Turkish courts have convicted him repeatedly in politically charged cases, most recently on July 16, 2025 and September 11, 2026.
  - Other hearings also fall in the window: the expert-witness case on December 8, the espionage case on December 23 and the diploma case on December 25. Each adds a little probability.
- **For No:**
  - Courts frequently adjourn. The diploma case has been adjourned five times.
  - The CHP case has nine defendants, so the defense may ask for more time, which could push the verdict past December 31.
  - The diploma case is waiting on the Council of State.
  - The expert-witness case is expected to be dismissed after the pre-payment.
  - The espionage and İBB trials are far from a verdict.
